insert_index.description: Position in the slide's object order at which the new connectors are placed. They are appended after the last object when omitted.

elements.description: Connectors to insert, from 1 to 50 in a single call. Mandatory.

connector.description: The connector to create, with its routing, endpoints and stroke. Its id is generated by the server. Mandatory.

connected.description: The two shapes the new connector joins, carrying the attachment point and arrowhead for each end. Mandatory.

first.description: The shape and attachment point the connector starts from.

second.description: The shape and attachment point the connector ends at.

type.description: How the new connector routes between the two shapes: LINE runs straight, ELBOW turns at right angles, CURVE bends smoothly.

stroke.description: Line style, thickness and color of the new connector.

captype.description: How the connector line ends: FLAT stops at the endpoint, CAPROUND adds a half-circle, SQUARE adds a half-square.

jointype.description: How two segments of the connector meet at a turn: ROUND curves the join, BEVEL cuts it flat, MITER extends it to a sharp point.

width.description: Thickness of the connector line, in pixels.

position.description: Where the drawn line sits relative to the routed path: CENTER straddles it, INSIDE or OUTSIDE offsets it to one side.

type.description: Line style of the connector: SOLID for an unbroken line, DASH for dashes, SQUARE_DOT for square dots.

fill.description: Paint used to draw the connector line. Only a solid color is supported here, since connectors cannot be turned off with no_fill.

solid.description: Flat color the connector line is drawn in. Mandatory, as connectors support no other fill variant.

color.description: The single flat color painted across the whole filled area. Mandatory.

hsb.description: Color expressed as hue, saturation and brightness. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

saturation.description: Intensity of the hue, from 0 for a fully desaturated gray to 1 for the pure color. Mandatory.

brightness.description: Brightness of the color, from 0 for black to 1 for the fully lit hue. Mandatory.

hue.description: Position on the color wheel in degrees, from 0 to 360, where 0 is red, 120 green and 240 blue. Mandatory.

hex.description: Color expressed as a hex string such as #4A90D9. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

value.description: Color written as a hex string, for example #4A90D9. Up to 20 characters. Mandatory.

rgb.description: Color expressed as red, green and blue channel values. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

red.description: Red channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

green.description: Green channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

blue.description: Blue channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

alpha.description: Opacity of the connector line's paint, given as a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0.

name.description: Display name for the new connector, shown in the editor's object list. Up to 500 characters.

elements.description: Per-connector patches, from 1 to 50 in a single call, each naming its target connector by id. Mandatory.

id.description: UUID of the connector this entry patches. Mandatory.

text.description: Text edits and styling to apply to the connector's label.

mutations.description: Text edits applied in order, up to 100, each targeting a character range, a cursor position or the whole text.

cursor.description: Cursor-scoped insert text, insert newline or delete newline at one index; exactly one of range, cursor or all_text.

cursor_index.description: Character position on the flattened text where the mutation happens (0 = before the first character).

text.description: Text to insert; required for INSERT_TEXT and ignored otherwise.

operation.description: CURSOR_TEXT_OPERATION_INSERT_TEXT inserts text; INSERT_NEWLINE splits the paragraph at the cursor; DELETE_NEWLINE merges the paragraph with the previous one.

all_text.description: Whole-text replace or delete; exactly one of range, cursor or all_text.

replacement_text.description: New text for REPLACE (required for that operation); ignored for DELETE.

operation.description: ALL_TEXT_OPERATION_REPLACE replaces the whole text with replacement_text; ALL_TEXT_OPERATION_DELETE clears it.

range.description: Range-scoped replace or delete over [start_index, end_index); exactly one of range, cursor or all_text.

replacement_text.description: New text for REPLACE (required for that operation); ignored for DELETE.

range.description: Half-open character range {start_index, end_index} of the flattened text to act on.

operation.description: RANGE_TEXT_OPERATION_REPLACE replaces the range with replacement_text; RANGE_TEXT_OPERATION_DELETE removes it.

styles.description: Styling entries applied after the mutations, up to 100. Each names the text it covers and the style to put on it.

all_text.description: Applies the style to every character in the text object. Set either range or all_text, never both.

portion_style.description: REST-v1 character styling. Use legacy font_name and named fontweight; the adapter converts these to the current SDK PortionStyle before dispatch.

fontweight.description: Stroke weight of the text, lightest to heaviest: THIN, EXTRA_LIGHT, LIGHT, NORMAL, MEDIUM, DEMI_BOLD, BOLD, HEAVY, BLACK.

size.description: Font size of this run of text, in points.

color.description: Color the text of this run is drawn in.

underline.description: Whether this run of text carries an underline.

strike.description: Whether this run of text is struck through.

italic.description: Whether this run of text is slanted.

font_name.description: Font family and variant applied to this run of text.

name.description: Font family applied to the text. Must be one of the families Zoho Show bundles; any other name is rejected.

style.description: Variant of that family to use, such as Regular, Bold or Italic. Up to 100 characters.

range.description: The span of characters the style applies to. Set either range or all_text, never both.

paragraph_style.description: Paragraph-level styling to apply, such as alignment, spacing or indent level. At least one of portion_style or paragraph_style is required.

halign.description: Horizontal alignment: LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT or JUSTIFY.

properties.description: Replacement stroke for the connector, covering its line style, thickness and color.

captype.description: How a border line ends: FLAT stops at the endpoint, CAPROUND adds a half-circle, SQUARE adds a half-square.

jointype.description: How two border segments meet at a corner: ROUND curves the join, BEVEL cuts it flat, MITER extends it to a sharp point.

width.description: Thickness of the border line, in pixels.

position.description: Where the border sits relative to the shape outline: CENTER straddles it, INSIDE keeps it within the shape, OUTSIDE draws it beyond the shape.

type.description: Line style of the border: SOLID for an unbroken line, DASH for dashes, SQUARE_DOT for square dots. To remove the border entirely set fill.no_fill instead of this field.

fill.description: Paint used to draw the border line. Carries either a solid color or no_fill, which turns the border off.

solid.description: Paints the border with a single flat color. Set either solid or no_fill, never both.

color.description: The single flat color painted across the whole filled area. Mandatory.

no_fill.description: No stroke fill — stroke-off toggle (oneof variant)

alpha.description: Opacity of the border paint, given as a ratio from 0.0 to 1.0.

data.description: Operation payload; endpoint-specific schemas narrow this where available.

hsb.description: Color expressed as hue, saturation and brightness. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

hex.description: Color expressed as a hex string such as #4A90D9. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

rgb.description: Color expressed as red, green and blue channel values. Set exactly one of rgb, hsb or hex.

side.description: Which edge of the shape the connector meets: NORTH, EAST, SOUTH or WEST. UNKNOWN_SIDE leaves the server to pick the side that routes best. Set either side or point, never both.

marker.description: Arrowhead drawn at this end of the connector: NONE for a bare line, or OPEN, BLOCK, CLASSIC, DIAMOND or OVAL. DEF_MARKER_TYPE keeps the existing default.

shape_id.description: UUID of the shape this end of the connector attaches to.

point.description: Exact attachment spot in the shape's own coordinate space, for when a named edge is not precise enough. Set either side or point, never both.

saturation.description: Intensity of the hue, from 0 for a fully desaturated gray to 1 for the pure color. Mandatory.

brightness.description: Brightness of the color, from 0 for black to 1 for the fully lit hue. Mandatory.

hue.description: Position on the color wheel in degrees, from 0 to 360, where 0 is red, 120 green and 240 blue. Mandatory.

value.description: Color written as a hex string, for example #4A90D9. Up to 20 characters. Mandatory.

x.description: Horizontal position in canvas units, measured rightward from the left edge of the viewbox.

y.description: Vertical position in canvas units, measured downward from the top edge of the viewbox.

red.description: Red channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

green.description: Green channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

blue.description: Blue channel intensity, an integer from 0 to 255. Mandatory.

start_index.description: Inclusive start character index on the flattened text (0-based).

end_index.description: Exclusive end character index; must be greater than start_index.
